parsed.note_claim: Three Chinese nationals were arrested in Georgia in October 2025 for attempting to buy 2kg of uranium, and reports do not specify the isotope (Uranium-235).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Three Chinese nationals have been arrested in Georgia on suspicion of attempting to illegally purchase 2kg of uranium.
parsed.reason: The BBC article directly confirms the arrest of three Chinese nationals in Georgia over 2kg of uranium and states it is unclear which isotope was sought.
